releases.title: First beta
releases.summary: Segue's first public release on the Mac App Store.

highlights.text: Paste a chord sheet from a website: Segue turns it into ChordPro and shows you the result before saving.
On-device AI checks the sections, title and artist of a paste. Nothing you paste leaves your Mac.
Stage mode that fits every song on one screen, never below your minimum size.
Build a set by ticking songs in order or typing a request, with per-show key and capo, breaks and running totals.
The song card: key, tempo, length (with Time it), capo and tags as controls, nothing to memorise.
Arrange a song for one gig: skip, repeat or reorder its sections without changing the song.
A visual metronome on stage, and a click in rehearsals.
Import ChordPro, text and .crd files by dragging them onto the library.
